purpose: Where in a video, podcast or talk is a topic discussed? Returns summaries of matching passages with the recording's title and link, not transcript text.
What has been published about one project, given its directory slug? Returns dated summaries of articles, talks, events and research with source links.
Which published items mention a named project, organization or token? Returns articles, talks, events, governance proposals and SCF submissions naming it, with match confidence.
Which projects resemble a known project? Given its directory slug, returns similar projects ranked by similarity, each with slug, title and description.
Which Stellar Community Fund submissions cover a topic or resemble a given proposal? Returns ranked submissions with round, category, award type and linked projects.
Which category values does the Lumenloop project directory use? Returns the full list of category names and slugs for exact filtering.
What does one content item say, given its collection and id? Returns title, link, short and long summaries, tags and dates, not the full text.
What does the Lumenloop directory record for one project, given its slug? Returns description, category, tags, website and social links, regions and SCF awards.
Which tag values can label a directory project? Returns the full list of project tag names and slugs.
Which regions do directory projects report as their base or operating area? Returns the list of region names in use.
Which ecosystem projects does one article, talk, event or research item mention? Given the item's id, returns the mentioned projects with slug, title and category.
What did one project submit to the Stellar Community Fund? Returns each submission's round, category, award status, funding amount and full proposal text.
Which tag values label articles and audio-video content? Returns the list of content tag names.
What are the newest, past or upcoming items in one collection, such as articles, events, videos or research? Returns a sorted, paged list of summaries.
Which research and roundup pieces has Lumenloop itself written? Returns previews with id, title, format, status and creation date, not full bodies.
What has been said or published about a topic? Searches all articles, talks, events and research by meaning and returns dated summaries with source links.
Which Stellar ecosystem projects match a name, keyword or category? Returns projects with slug, title, description, category and tags, using similarity when nothing matches literally.
Is there an article, event, video or research item whose title or link contains these exact words? Returns matching item summaries from one collection.
What are the ecosystem-wide totals? Returns dated rollups: hackathon and SCF funding, category distribution, DeFi value locked, monthly active developers, toolchain versions and underbuilt areas.
How do two to five hackathons differ? Returns side-by-side figures for each event and the category and package shares that shifted most between them.
How does a Stellar repository implement something in its code? Returns an answer grounded in that repo's source files, naming the repo and its sources.
Which individual builders have a given skill or location? Returns builder profiles with bio, role, location and shipped projects.
What changed recently in the Scout API itself? Returns a latest-first list of added, removed or altered endpoints, parameters and descriptions.
Which Scout project, repo or partner records changed since a given time? Returns the changed rows, newest first, with the kind of fact that moved.
Which areas of the ecosystem are crowded and which are underbuilt? Returns topic clusters with size, crowdedness score, SCF funding, hackathon winners and sample projects.
What happened at one hackathon? Given its slug, returns every submission with placement, prize and track, the winners, per-track totals and any stored event rules.
Which Stellar hackathons exist, and which are upcoming, active or finished? Returns events with dates, status, organizer and prize pool.
Which Stellar projects are most active? Returns projects ranked by recent commits, stars, open issues or value locked, with GitHub figures and ecosystem developer counts.
What does one service partner offer? Given its slug, returns the full profile: services, sectors, regions, documentation, contact, verified signals and freshness.
Which service providers can a builder hire or integrate, such as anchors, ramps, wallets or audit firms? Returns listings filterable by type, sector and region.
Who holds which role at the Stellar Development Foundation? Returns leadership, board members and advisors with name, role and the source page.
Can this GitHub repository be depended on? Returns evidence for one repo: maintenance activity, audit reports, mainnet usage, successor repos and its extracted contract interface.
What does the ecosystem want built, and is paid work open? Returns sponsor briefs with status, plus the live SCF round and its submission window.
What does one listed AI skill contain, and how is it installed? Given its name, returns metadata and, for skills.stellar.org entries, the full SKILL.md text.
Which stablecoins exist on Stellar, and how large are they? Returns each with dollar market cap, supply, peg, holders, price, issuer account and measurement basis.
Is the Scout service healthy, and how fresh is its data? Returns service versions with freshness and record counts for each data source.
What should a hackathon team know before building an idea? Returns competitors, prior art, starter repositories with trust summaries, verified live contracts, funding and cautions.
Which security audit reports exist for Stellar projects? Returns one row per report with auditor, project, publication date, report link and finding counts where extracted.
Which mainnet Soroban contracts are verified, and which project owns them? Returns contract ids with repo, project, interface preview, live usage figures and audit records.
Which AI skills, MCP servers, SDKs and CLIs can a Stellar builder install? Returns directory entries with kind, source, install command and repository links.
Which service partners best fit a need described in plain language? Returns published partners ranked by fit, each with a one-line reason.
What is an old or unfamiliar project name called now? Returns the matching record, its successor if renamed or replaced, and evidence for inactive status.
What should an SCF pitch for this idea stress? Returns the live round and deadline, funded peers with award totals, prior art and pitch angles.
Has anyone built this at a Stellar hackathon? Returns matching submissions with event, placement, repository and demo links, linked project and the SDKs used.
What is this project, or which products already exist for a need? Returns directory records with builder, status, SCF funding, links, repositories and on-chain metrics.
Which GitHub repositories implement something on Stellar? Returns indexed repos with a discovery score, language, activity level and links, as code to read or fork.
What do SEPs, CAPs, audits, incident reports, SDF posts and the SCF handbook say about a topic? Returns cited passages with source, link and dates.
Is this build idea already taken on Stellar? Returns competitor repos and projects with maturity, hackathon prior art, a supply-side gap reading and SCF funding.
How do I position an SCF idea against earlier submissions? A playbook with a recipe, a worked example and a positioning-brief template.
How do I turn a Stellar product idea into a build path? A playbook for choosing primitives, checking prior art and picking a build skill.
How do I fact-check a draft post about Stellar? A playbook for resolving project names and handles, finding citations and flagging unsupported claims.
What is new in an area of Stellar or for a named entity? A runnable digest returning dated, cited recent news, talks, events and research.
How do I map a sector of the Stellar ecosystem? A playbook for a landscape of projects, categories, regions and related content, with a template.
Which existing wallet, oracle, anchor or other tool should I integrate? A playbook for choosing a project and the matching build skill.
How do I build a due-diligence profile of one project? A playbook covering its details, coverage, talks, SCF history and similar projects, with a template.
How do I add OpenZeppelin components, such as tokens, access control or pausing, to a contract? A playbook on library patterns and contract generators.
How do I set up a Soroban project with OpenZeppelin Contracts for Stellar? Covers toolchain installation, dependencies, import conventions, and building and testing.
How do I make a Soroban contract upgradeable and upgrade it safely? Covers the OpenZeppelin upgradeable module, migrations, storage compatibility and access control.
How do I charge AI agents for an API, or pay as an agent? Covers x402 paid APIs, the Machine Payments Protocol and testnet setup.
How do I issue and manage an asset on Stellar? Covers issuance, trustlines, authorization flags, clawback, regulated assets and the Stellar Asset Contract.
How do I move tokens or messages between Stellar and other chains? A rail-selection guide covering CCTP for USDC, Axelar, LayerZero and NEAR Intents.
How do I build a web or Node app on Stellar? Covers the JavaScript SDK, wallet connection, passkey smart accounts, and building and submitting transactions.
How do I read chain data such as balances, transactions and contract events? Covers Stellar RPC, Horizon, historical data and migrating from Horizon to RPC.
How do I write, test, secure and deploy a Soroban contract in Rust? Covers setup, contract anatomy, storage, authorization, testing methods, vulnerability classes and checklists.
Which SEP or CAP applies to my use case? A quick map of standards for wallets, anchors, payments and KYC, with ecosystem and documentation references.
How do I verify zero-knowledge proofs in a Stellar contract? Covers the Groth16 verifier and walkthroughs for Circom, Noir and RISC Zero.
How do I use Scout to vet ideas, match RFPs, draft SCF pitches or find auditors? A playbook with workflows and an API reference.
How do I integrate Trustless Work escrow? Covers single-release and multi-release escrows, milestones, disputes, and the REST API, React SDK and Blocks components.
What does this whole documentation page say? Given a developers.stellar.org path, returns the page title and full content with headings, tables and code.
How do anchors and SEP integrations work? Returns doc sections on the Anchor Platform, deposits and withdrawals, cross-border payments, authentication, KYC and the Disbursement Platform.
How are assets and tokens issued and controlled? Returns doc sections on issuance, trustlines, authorization flags, clawback, the Stellar Asset Contract and the token interface.
Which documentation page covers a topic I can roughly name? Returns one row per page, ranked by title and path, with its link.
What does the official documentation say about any Stellar or Soroban topic? Searches every docs page and returns sections with title, heading, link and snippet.
What does one area of the documentation say? Searches a single top-level category, such as build, data, tools or learn, and returns matching sections.
When or why was a protocol change decided? Returns passages from protocol and developer meeting notes covering CAP discussions, upgrade votes and standards debates.
How does the protocol itself work? Returns doc sections on ledgers, accounts, transactions, operations, fees, consensus, liquidity pools, networks and resource limits.
How do I query chain data through the official APIs? Returns doc sections on Stellar RPC methods, Horizon endpoints and errors, Hubble analytics and indexers.
Which official tool or SDK does a job, and how is it used? Returns doc sections on SDKs, Stellar CLI, Lab, Quickstart and other tools.
How do I develop a Soroban contract according to the official docs? Returns sections on setup, storage and archival, authorization, events, testing, simulation and fees.
How do the official docs say to build a wallet, payment app or dapp? Returns tutorial and guide sections, including Freighter integration and passkey accounts.
What does one stellar.org page say? Given its path, such as the strategy, roadmap or audited-projects page, returns the title and main text.
What does SDF publish about its strategy, roadmap, programs, products or directories? Returns stellar.org pages, audit records with report links, video tutorials and partner listings.
